title: The FT's Andrew Hill names Incorruptible a best book of 2026
summary: Hill names the book one of his must-read business titles of 2026 in the FT's annual best-books series. He had interviewed Eric about it in May, and the list places it alongside Lynda Gratton's Living the 100-Year Life.
attribution_title: Senior Business Writer, Financial Times; Consulting Editor, FT Live
blockquote: Intrigued by the failure of some principled entrepreneurs to realise their goals, Ries looks into the forces that stand in their way. The author of The Lean Startup takes issue with “best practices”, such as quarterly reporting, that hold back visionary business leaders.
blockquote_source: Andrew Hill, “Best books of 2026: Business”, Financial Times

source_urls.label: Matt James, Senior Commissioning Editor at Penguin Life, on the listing
